# Soulbound Legends — Package Contents and Verification Boundary

## Unity scenes generated by the Builder
- `00_Opening`: opening scene, optional Inspector-assigned video, continue/login panel, Google/email provider notices and local guest-test route.
- `01_CharacterCreation`: element/look test controls and lobby transition.
- `02_Lobby`: 3D procedural lobby blockout and navigation to Adventure World, Clash/CS, Battle Royale and Siege; profile, events, free items, Luck Royale, Store/Aether, Vault, Armory, Emotes, Friends, World Chat, Settings and Mail panels.
- `03_AdventureWorld`: village blockout, vegetation, village hall/houses, NPCs, monsters, player, HUD, movement joystick, attack/elemental test buttons, quests, inventory, map, gathering, blacksmith and alchemy.
- `04_Clash`, `05_BattleRoyale`, `06_Siege`: generated arena/blockout scenes with gameplay HUD and test combat controls.
- `07_SupremeRuin`, `08_Rift`: generated ruin/rift blockout scenes with creature/boss blockouts and HUD.

## Implemented local foundation
- Editor Builder creates/saves nine scenes, generates primitive geometry/materials/UI, registers scenes in Build Settings and writes a report.
- Generated UI buttons have persistent click listeners for their assigned navigation, panel or local test action.
- Local inventory/material stacks, resource gathering, beginner sword/staff/bow blockout objects, equipment visibility toggles, potion crafting, blacksmith recipes, guild dialogue/status and a one-time test reward.
- Basic procedural actor geometry, test progression, simple combat hooks and third-person/mobile movement controls already present in the source archive.

## UI panel behavior
- Lobby panels open/close and show descriptive content. Store, mail, rewards, social/chat, events and draw panels are informational placeholders until their backing service/content catalog is implemented and configured.
- Adventure buttons open Quests, Inventory, Map, Blacksmith and Alchemy panels; Gather adds local test resources; recipe buttons check ingredient requirements; inventory refresh displays current local stacks; equip buttons show the selected blockout weapon on the player socket; guild actions update visible status text and award a local test reward once.
- Buttons requiring network services are not represented as live online features just because a panel exists.

## Not a finished commercial MMO
The archive does not prove full game completion. Generated environments and weapons use primitive/procedural blockout geometry; there are not production-quality models, textures, animation sets, complete voice/dialogue trees, all authored quests, full potion effects, full combat/equipment balancing, production anti-cheat, authoritative crafting/economy, or deployed multiplayer services for every feature. The online auth/database/network/economy components included elsewhere in the project need their documented external setup and integration testing.

## Required verification after opening in Unity 6000.5.6f1
1. Let Unity finish importing.
2. Read the Console and resolve all compile errors.
3. Open **Soulbound Legends → Game Builder** and press **VALIDATE GENERATED PROJECT**.
4. Press **BUILD GAME** to regenerate scenes with the added UI and local gameplay foundation.
5. Enter Play mode and test every button, inventory recipe, weapon equip action, movement, combat, scene navigation and scene transitions.
6. Test on a real Android device and test multiplayer only after backend/transport services are configured.
7. Build the APK only after validation and runtime testing. An APK build is not included or claimed by this archive.
